body.statement: For a finite-dimensional linear program in standard form with rational constraint matrix, rational right-hand side, and rational objective, if the primal is feasible and has a finite optimum then the primal and dual optimal values coincide and rational optimal basic feasible solutions exist.  Feasible rational primal and dual points whose objective values differ by at most a prescribed positive rational tolerance therefore certify lower and upper bounds with that gap.

attestation.note: Paraphrased from the cited linear-programming duality and rational-solution chapters; a stable DOI is supplied because no verbatim transcription was available.
